component.name: dns
component.title: DNS
component.description: Query DNS records and resolve host names to IP addresses, using the dnsjava library.
component.label: networking

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

CamelDnsClass.label: lookup dig
CamelDnsClass.description: The DNS class to query, as a dnsjava DClass mnemonic such as IN (the default), CH or HS. The lookup operation fails on an unknown class, while dig uses IN instead.

CamelDnsName.label: lookup dig
CamelDnsName.description: The domain name to query. For lookup, a name without a trailing dot can also be tried with the search domains of the system, while dig always queries the name as an absolute name.

CamelDnsDomain.label: ip
CamelDnsDomain.description: The host name to resolve to an IP address, with the resolver of the JVM (InetAddress.getByName). An IP address literal is returned as is.

CamelDnsServer.label: dig
CamelDnsServer.description: The host name or IP address of the DNS server to send the query to, on port 53. If not set, the first DNS server configured in the operating system is used.

CamelDnsType.label: lookup dig
CamelDnsType.description: The record type to query, as a dnsjava Type mnemonic such as A (the default), AAAA, MX or TXT. The lookup operation fails on an unknown type, while dig uses A instead.

CamelDnsTerm.label: wikipedia
CamelDnsTerm.deprecationNote: The Wikipedia over DNS service is no longer available
CamelDnsTerm.description: The search term, sent as a TXT query for the term followed by .wp.dg.cx. Deprecation note: The Wikipedia over DNS service is no longer available

producerIn.description: The body is not used: the name to query is in a header, CamelDnsDomain for ip, CamelDnsName for lookup and dig, and CamelDnsTerm for wikipedia

producerOut.description: By the type: for ip the InetAddress of the domain, which converts to the address as text; for lookup the records of the answer as an array of Record, and the lookup fails when there are none; for dig the response Message; for wikipedia the text of the first TXT record, or no body

dnsType.description: The operation to run: ip resolves the host name in the CamelDnsDomain header to an IP address with the resolver of the JVM; lookup runs a dnsjava lookup of the CamelDnsName header and returns the records of the answer; dig sends one query for the CamelDnsName header to a DNS server and returns the whole response. The wikipedia type is deprecated, as the Wikipedia over DNS service it queries is no longer available.

By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started.
